title: FileWriteRequested
description: Command: write a file under the File Storage Adapter's watch_dir, auto-creating it if it doesn't exist (Design.md Decision #19, §8, §12). This is the logical, pre-encryption shape of eventPayload — the wire envelope wraps this per §5. Published by the Webhook Listener (Decision #22) or any other adapter that needs a file written.

path.description: File path, relative to the File Storage Adapter's watch_dir. Must resolve to a location inside watch_dir — absolute paths, '..' traversal, and symlink escapes are rejected by the adapter (Design.md §12), not by this schema.

content.description: Raw file bytes, base64-encoded. Kept opaque/binary-safe rather than assuming text, since this command has no real external source shaping its contents yet (Decision #22).
